message: Dependabot proposes npm updates after 1 day (default-days: 1 in .github/dependabot.yml), but npm in web waits 3 days (min-release-age: 3 in web/.npmrc); its pull requests bring in versions younger than npm in web accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make the Dependabot delay at least 3 days, or run depcurfew apply
